field_evidence.yearly_file_scope: HM Land Registry's official Price Paid Data yearly-file page states that yearly files include standard and additional price-paid transactions received for each calendar year and are updated monthly.
field_evidence.2024_resource: The official 2024 yearly-file section exposes a complete CSV resource (approximately 157 MB) at the HM Land Registry publicdata host.
field_evidence.target_filter: Intended target filter is Forge Cottage; Ruckinge Road; TN25 7JX, with emitted/processed target records capped at 50.
field_evidence.transport_result: The official CSV resource URL resolved, but the available web transport rejected text/csv and the direct file-download transport failed, so no 2024 target transaction row or transaction unique identifier was retrieved in this window.
field_evidence.geometry_limit: Price Paid Data is transaction/address evidence and does not itself provide a registered-title/index-polygon geometry or canonical parcel bbox.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted without a retrieved target transaction record and subsequent authoritative title-boundary binding.

The web transport rejected the resource because text/csv is unsupported, and the direct download transport also failed. This is a materially different bulk-file transport method from the earlier target report-builder and SPARQL queries.
